title: Rescue
lyrics_original: You are not hidden
There's never been a moment
You were forgotten
You are not hopeless
Though you have been broken
Your innocence stolen
I hear you whisper underneath your breath
I hear your SOS
Your SOS
I will send out an army
To find you in the middle of the darkest night
It's true, I will rescue you
There is no distance
That cannot be covered
Over and over
You're not defenseless
I'll be your shelter
I'll be your armor
I hear you whisper underneath your breath
I hear your SOS, your SOS
I will send out an army
To find You in the middle of the darkest night
It's true, I will rescue you
And I will never stop marching
To reach you in the middle of the hardest fight
It's true, I will rescue you
I hear the whisper underneath your breath
I hear you whisper you have nothing left
I will send out an army
To find you in the middle of the darkest night
It's true, I will rescue you
And I will never stop marching
To reach you in the middle of the hardest fight
It's true, I will rescue you
Oh, I will rescue you

bible_verses.telugu: విరిగిన హృదయముగలవారికి యెహోవా ఆసన్నుడు నలిగిన మనస్సుగలవారిని ఆయన రక్షించును.
bible_verses.english: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా, నీవు నన్ను పరిశోధించి తెలిసికొని యున్నావు నేను కూర్చుండుట నేను లేచుట నీకు తెలియును నాకు తలంపు పుట్టకమునుపే నీవు నా మనస్సు గ్రహించుచున్నావు.
bible_verses.english: You have searched me, Lord, and you know me. You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.

bible_verses.telugu: స్త్రీ తన గర్భమున పుట్టిన బిడ్డను కరుణింపకుండ తన  చంటిపిల్లను మరచునా? వారైన మరచుదురు గాని నేను నిన్ను మరువను.
bible_verses.english: Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You that I am never hidden from Your sight or forgotten by Your heart. When I feel overwhelmed and broken, remind me that You hear my quietest cries for help. I surrender my pain to You and choose to trust in Your fierce, gentle love. Thank You for coming to my rescue and wrapping me in Your peace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, thank You that I am never hidden from Your sight or forgotten by Your heart. When I feel overwhelmed and broken, remind me that You hear my quietest cries for help. I surrender my pain to You and choose to trust in Your fierce, gentle love. Thank You for coming to my rescue and wrapping me in Your peace. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: No matter how deep your brokenness or how quiet your cry for help feels, you are never hidden from God’s tender care. He knows every hurt you carry and hears even the faintest whisper of your heart. In your moments of deepest despair, Jesus sees you and moves with infinite love to rescue you. As you sing today, rest in the comforting truth that you are fully known, deeply loved, and never forgotten.
